thread:
jules: Hey team, customer on Vercel/Next edge sees streaming completions abruptly cut off after ~2-3s. Using @redwood/inference-js v0.11.0, Node 18 edge runtime. No obvious 4xx from our API, but client gets 'done: true' mid-response. Repro link + minimal app attached to ticket.

maria-support: Thanks Jules — can you paste the minimal server handler? Also do they see any 401/402 before the cut? :thinking:

jules: here's the handler they used:
```ts
// app/api/generate/route.ts (edge)
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'

export const runtime = 'edge'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })

export async function GET() {
  const stream = await client.chat.completions.stream({ model: 'redwood-1' , messages: [{role:'user', content:'long story'}] })
  return new NextResponse(stream)
}
```
They also tried creating a Response with `new Response(stream)` and got the same truncation. No 401/402 in their logs, but they did see occasional 429s earlier for a different user.

devx-joe: Could be Next's edge runtime clamping streaming durations or Vercel's max idle time. Do they have middleware or image optimization running? Those can consume the stream.

eng-runtime-ash: A few thoughts: 1) SDK v0.11.0 changed internal ReadableStream usage; Node's edge polyfills + Next's body mix can cause double-consumption. 2) If the platform closes the request (timeout or keepalive) you'll get done:true.

sara-oncall: I asked the customer to run this repro locally (node --experimental-edge) and on Vercel. Locally the stream completes fine. On Vercel it cuts at ~2.8s every time.

maria-support: Can they share a HAR or server logs showing connection close? Also ask them to try pinning SDK to v0.10.4 as a quick check.

jules: customer tried pinning to 0.10.4 — streaming works end-to-end. So it's likely a regression in v0.11.x interacting with edge. They also confirmed no billing errors during the failing runs.

eng-runtime-ash: OK that's actionable. Quick workaround: downgrade to 0.10.4 or switch to returning a Response with `new Response(stream, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream' }})` AND ensure no middleware touches the body. Long-term we'll revert the internal ReadableStream branching or add an edge-safe path.

devx-joe: Small repro tweak that helped one customer: wrap SDK stream with a TransformStream to avoid exposing the SDK's native reader to Next's piping internals:
```ts
const ts = new TransformStream()
client.chat.completions.stream(...).pipeTo(ts.writable)
return new Response(ts.readable)
```
That made Vercel happy in their case.

maria-support: I've flagged this to eng-runtime-ash + added to the ticket. Also created a support KB: "Edge streaming truncation with v0.11.x" with downgrade steps and the transform-stream workaround.

support-bot: NOTE: Created incident linked ticket #INC-2025 for streaming regression triage — assigned to eng-runtime-ash.

eng-runtime-ash: I'll take ownership of a small patch to restore previous stream semantics for edge builds and add an integration test on Vercel. ETA: ~48h. In the meantime we'll recommend pinning to 0.10.4 or using the TransformStream shim.

jules: thanks — I'll update the customer. If we see auth/billing errors crop up I'll re-open but for now this looks like an SDK/edge compatibility bug.
